# Release 6.1.1 — 2026-10-23

## Summary

ycc 6.1.1 is a toolchain security patch. Repository CI and mise now pin the Node.js October 2026 security releases (22.23.4 and 24.22.1), and the dev dependency tree pins markdown-it to 14.3.3. Plugin behavior is unchanged.

## Added

None this release.

## Changed

## Removed

None this release.

# Release 6.1.0 — 2026-10-23

## Summary

ycc 6.1.0 adds native support for OMP (oh-my-pi), with omp 18.12.2 or later. The `ycc`, `ycc-mcp` and `ycc-rules` OMP packages are listed in the root `.omp-plugin/marketplace.json`. `install.sh --target omp` installs, updates, removes and migrates them at user or project scope. The release also adds item selection to `install.sh` (`--skills`, `--agents`, `--commands`, `--plugins`, `--mods`, `--hooks` and `--with-deps`), and fixes for the opencode restricted-agent permissions. A new live CI workflow runs the OMP acceptance harnesses against pinned omp releases on Linux and macOS.

# Release 6.0.0 — 2026-10-17

## Summary

ycc 6.0.0 ships native packages in every runtime marketplace. Claude now lists `ycc-mcp`, `ycc-hooks`, and `ycc-all` alongside `ycc`; Codex lists `ycc` and `ycc-mcp` in a renamed `ycc` catalog; and Cursor gains a root marketplace with `ycc`, `ycc-mcp`, `ycc-hooks`, and `ycc-rules`. `install.sh` file copy remains the fallback, and `install.sh migrate` moves an existing install to the native packages.

# Release 5.3.0 — 2026-10-15

## Summary

ycc moves skill-managed worktrees to per-runtime, repo-local roots (`.claude/`, `.codex/`, `.cursor/`, `.opencode/worktrees/`), makes `AGENTS.md` the canonical rules file emitted by `ycc:init`, and retires the `ycc/commands/` wrapper layer in favor of native skill invocations. Validators gain a practices ratchet plus `.claude/rules` frontmatter and root-import budget checks, maintainer and destructive workflows are marked user-invocation-only, and a large maintenance pass splits oversized skills into lazy references.

## Upgrade Notes

No breaking changes to skill or agent names. Plugin-based installs need no action; standalone and repo-local installs have the follow-ups below.

# Release 5.2.1 — 2026-10-09

## Summary

## Added
